DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今年一年、私たち便利屋68への温かいご支援とご愛顧を賜り、誠にありがとうございました

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: な、なによ！その反応！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ごめん、ちょっとビックリしてた

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 一応送り主の確認を…

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まっ、まあ良いわ！私は寛大だもの！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: とにかく堅苦しい挨拶はこれで終わり！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さあ先生、今年も残りわずかね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 年末年始に向けてやることがあるの、だから今日は私に付き合いなさい？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちなみに同業者である先生に、拒否する権利はないわ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: えっと、先生、予定空いてるわよね……？ね……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あらためて言っておこうかしら、あけましておめでとうございます

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: あけましておめでとう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日連絡をしたのは他でもないわ……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この間、着物をレンタルしたでしょう？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ああ、アルが押されっぱなしだった時の

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もしあれだったら、一緒にお店に行って返品できないか聞いてみる？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 違うわよ、そうじゃなくて！というかあの時のあれは、あくまで戦略的な投資よ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ただ今日は、その着物の使い道ができたってことを教えようと思って……！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 使い道……事務所に飾る、とか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そのためだけに先生を呼ぶわけがないでしょう！？っていうか普通に、分かってて言ってるわよね！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 着もしないで飾るなんて悲しすぎるでしょう！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……と、とにかく！この着物を着ていく場所ができたのよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それも着物が相応しい、かなり上品な席……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: だからその、先生にエスコートをお願いしようと思ったのだけど……どうかしら？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: も、もちろん私ひとりでも問題無いのだけれど！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……忙しい、かしら？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もちろん行くよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そ、そうよね！？やっぱり来てくれるわよね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ、じゃあ待ってるわよ♪

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、この間話したこと覚えてるわよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちょっと遅くなってしまったけれど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: せっかくのお正月なのに、先生とお正月らしいイベントにも行けてないでしょう？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: お互いに忙しかったもんね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: イベント、周回、アイテム……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そうよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……先生、大丈夫？何の話？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まあだからとにかく、その……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日、ちょっと時間をくれないかしら？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、新年が始まったわね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: となると、この時期にしか無いイベントをやっておくのも、事業家として為すべきことの一つだと思わない？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そう、別に信じているわけではないのだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ええ決して、断じてそういうわけではないけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私と一緒に、おみくじを引きに行きましょう？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……アル、すごくおみくじ信じてる方？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その話は良いから！早く来なさい！

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 올 한 해 저희 흥신소 68에 보내주신 귀하의 관심과 사랑에 진심으로 감사드립니다.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭐, 뭐야! 그 꺼림칙한 반응은!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 갑자기 이상한 인사를 보내서 당황했을 뿐이야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 아루답지 않게 이상한 문자를 보내길래 스팸인 줄 알았어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭐, 뭐어. 괜찮아! 나는 관대하니까!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……후후후훗, 딱딱한 인사는 이걸로 끝!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 자, 선생님, 올해도 얼마 남지 않았어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 말인데 오늘은 나와 어울려줘.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 참고로 동업자인 선생님에게 거부권은 없으니까 말이야!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님 예정, 비어 있는 거 맞지……? 응…?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 새해 복 많이 받으세요. 선생님.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 응, 아루도 새해 복 많이 받아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 흠흠, 오늘 이렇게 연락을 한 건 다름이 아니라…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 요전번에 그……. 비싼 기모노를 렌탈한 적이 있었잖아?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 응, 아루, 엄청 팔랑귀였지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 역시 반품하러 같이 가줄까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 자, 잠깐! 그때의 그건, 어디까지나 전략적인 투자의 일환이었고!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘 이렇게 연락한 건 마침 그 옷의 쓰임새가 생긴 걸 알려주려고……!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 확실히 방에 장식하면 이쁠 거 같긴 했지. 거들어줄까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 딱히 사무실에 장식하려고 선생님을 부르려던 게 아니거든?!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭐냐고! 쓰임새가 생겼다고 당당하게 외친 직후에 그런 처량한 전개……!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……어, 어쨌거나 이 옷을 입고 갈 장소가 생겼어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 고급스러운 기모노가 어울리는, 매우 중요한 자리거든.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 말이지만…… 어때, 선생님. 에스코트를 부탁하고 싶은데……. 같이 가지 않을래?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……무, 물론 나 혼자서도 완전 괜찮지만? 응, 아무런 문제도 없긴 하지만 그래도……!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……같이 가줄 거지?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 응, 물론이야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 후후, 그럼 기다리고 있을게♪

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 저번에 했던 이야기의 연장선인데 말이야…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그, 조금 늦어지게 됐지만…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아직 새해인데도 모처럼 선생님하고 새해다운 행사에 참가하질 못했잖아?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 바빠서 그럴 시간이 없긴 했었지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 윽 이벤트 참가, 아이템 파밍……!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그렇지?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 응? 무슨 말을 하는 거야, 선생님은?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 말인데…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘, 나한테 시간 좀 내어주지 않을래? 선생님.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 새해야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그럼 이런 시기에만 존재하는 이벤트를 경험해 보는 것도 사업가로서 당연히 갖춰야 할 태도가 아닐까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 응, 딱히 믿는 건 아니지만.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 응, 절대로 그런 건 아니지만.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 나랑 같이 오미쿠지를 뽑으러 가자.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 오히려 그런 말을 할수록 믿고 있는 게…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 돼, 됐고! 집합이야!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: We sincerely thank you for your interest and love for Problem Solver 68 this year.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: H-Hey! What's with that awkward reaction!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I was just taken aback by your sudden strange greeting.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I thought it was spam because it wasn't like your usual messages.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: W-Well, it's okay! Because I am magnanimous!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heeheehee, no more formal greetings!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, this year is almost over.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So on that note, hang out with me today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: By the way, as my business partner, you do not have the right to veto!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Um...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Your schedule is free today...right?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Happy New Year, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Happy New Year to you too, Aru.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ahem, I have a good reason for contacting you like this...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Last time...I rented that expensive kimono, remember?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Yeah, you were so gullible, Aru.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Would you like me to go return it with you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: W-Wait! About that, it was part of a strategic investment!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I contacted you today to let you know I found a way to put the outfit to good use!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I did think it would be pretty on display in a room. Need help?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm not asking for your help just because I want to display it in the office!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Come on! What's with this sad development right after I proudly shouted that I have a good use for it!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...A-Anyway, I have a place to go to in that outfit.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's a very important meeting where an elegant kimono would fit right in.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: On that note... What do you say, Sensei? I want to ask you to be my escort. Would you like to go with me?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...O-Of course, I'm perfectly fine on my own. Yeah, no problem at all, but still!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...Will you go with me?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Yes, of course.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh... Yay!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee, okay then. I'll be waiting! ♪

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, I would like to continue what I was talking about last time...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So, it is a bit late, but...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's still New Year's, but I haven't been able to participate in any events with you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It was too busy for us to do any of that.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Ugh, participating in events, farming items...!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yeah?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Huh? What are you talking about, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So, I was just wondering...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Will you spend time with me today, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, it's the new year.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: As a business owner, it's natural to want to take advantage of events that only happen during this time of year.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Not that I'm superstitious or anything.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Certainly not. That's definitely not the case. Nevertheless...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What do you say to drawing omikuji together?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Saying something like that makes it seem like you believe...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Wh-Whatever! Let's get together!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ขอบคุณคุณครูมากๆ ที่สนใจ
และมอบความรักให้กับหน่วยรับจ้าง
สารพัด 68 ของเรานะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อะไรกัน! ทำไมถึง
ตอบกลับแปลกๆ แบบนี้!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูแค่ตกใจที่จู่ๆ
เธอก็ทักทายแบบแปลกๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
พอเห็นข้อความที่ไม่สมกับเป็นอารุ
เลยนึกว่าเป็นข้อความสแปมน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อะ...อะไรกัน แต่ช่างเถอะ!
ฉันเป็นคนใจกว้าง ไม่ถือหรอก!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮุฮุฮุ ทักทายเป็นพิธีพอแล้ว!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู อีกไม่นานปีนี้ก็จะผ่านไปแล้วนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เพราะงั้นวันนี้ไปเที่ยวกับฉันหน่อยสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ขอบอกเอาไว้ก่อน หุ้นส่วนธุรกิจ
อย่างคุณครูไม่มีสิทธิ์ปฏิเสธเด็ดขาด!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้คุณครูว่างอยู่ใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: สวัสดีปีใหม่ค่ะ คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
อื้อ ปีใหม่นี้
มีความสุขมากๆ นะ อารุ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืมมม ที่ฉันติดต่อมาวันนี้...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คราวก่อนเราไปเช่าชุด
กิโมโนราคาแพงมา

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ อารุตกลงเช่าง่ายๆ เลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ให้ไปคืนเป็นเพื่อนเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ดะ...เดี๋ยวสิ! ตอนนั้นมัน...
เป็นแค่ส่วนหนึ่งของกลยุทธ์
การลงทุนเท่านั้น!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ที่ติดต่อมาวันนี้ก็เพื่อจะบอกว่ามีโอกาสเหมาะๆ ที่จะใช้ชุดนั้นแล้วน่ะ...!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าเอามาตกแต่งห้องก็คงจะสวย
มากแน่ๆ ให้ครูช่วยมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันไม่ได้จะเรียกคุณครูมา
ตกแต่งสำนักงานสักหน่อยนะ?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ทั้งที่ฉันบอกว่ามีโอกาสเหมาะๆ
ที่จะใช้ชุดนี้แล้ว ทำไมถึงพูดเรื่อง
พวกนี้ออกมากันเนี่ย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ยังไงก็เถอะ เอาเป็นว่า
มีงานเลี้ยงให้ใส่ชุดนี้ไปได้แล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
งานสำคัญมากเหมาะกับ
กิโมโนชั้นสูงแบบนี้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เพราะงั้นคุณครูจะว่ายังไง
ถ้าฉันอยากจะขอให้ไปด้วยกันน่ะ
จะไปด้วยกันมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
นะ...แน่นอนว่าฉันไปคนเดียวก็ได้
ไปคนเดียวได้สบายๆ ไม่มีปัญหาเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่คุณครูจะไปด้วยกันใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ ไปสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อะ...อื้อ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮุฮุ ถ้างั้นฉันจะรอนะ♪

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู ฉันอยากคุยเรื่องนั้น
ต่อจากคราวที่แล้วน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถึงมันจะช้าไปสักหน่อย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ปีใหม่ทั้งที แต่ฉันยังไม่ได้
ไปเที่ยวงานปีใหม่กับคุณครูเลยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เรายุ่งจนไม่มีเวลาไปเลยนี่นา

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
อึก... เข้าร่วมกิจกรรม
ฟาร์มไอเทม...!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ใช่มั้ยล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หืม? พูดอะไรของคุณครูน่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เพราะงั้น...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้คุณครูไปเที่ยวกับฉันมั้ย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู ปีใหม่แล้วนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ในฐานะนักธุรกิจ การออกไป
สำรวจงานเทศกาลพิเศษแบบนี้
ก็เป็นเรื่องที่ควรทำไม่ใช่รึไง?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม ถึงฉันจะไม่ค่อยเชื่อเท่าไรก็เถอะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ มันไม่ได้เป็นแบบนั้นเสมอไปหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เราไปเสี่ยงทายโอะมิกุจิกันเถอะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไหนบอกว่าไม่เชื่อไง...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ชะ...ช่างเหอะน่า! รีบออกมาได้แล้ว!

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今年一年，承蒙您對我們便利屋68的熱情支持與惠顧，誠心感謝

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 什，什麼呀！那種反應！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 抱歉，剛剛有點嚇一跳

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 先確認發送人是誰……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 算……算了！我是很寬容大量的！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 總之，拘謹的寒暄到此為止！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 吶，老師，今年也只剩一點點了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 為了準備跨年有些事要做，所以今天會陪我吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 順帶一提，身為合夥人的老師沒有拒絕的權利！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那個，老師，日程還空著吧……？是吧……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我姑且就再說一次吧，新年快樂

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 新年快樂

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天聯絡不為別的……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 之前不是租了和服嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 啊啊，是亞瑠被牽著鼻子走的那時候的

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 如果是那個話，要一起去店裡詢問是否能退貨嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不是的，不是那樣！應該說那時候的那個，說到底都是戰略性的投資！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天只是想告訴你，那件和服有用處了……！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 用處……裝飾辦公室之類的？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不可能只為了這個就叫老師吧！？話說回來，你明明知道吧！？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 連穿都沒穿就拿去裝潢，太傷心了吧！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……總，總之！有能穿這件和服的地方了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是與和服相配，相當文雅的場合……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以，我想拜託老師護送我……如何？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 當，當然，我自己一個人也沒問題的！？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……會很忙嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 當然會去唷

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是，是啊！果然會來啊！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 呵呵，那我等著唷♪

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，你還記得上次說的話吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然有點晚了……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 難得的新年，都沒能跟老師一起參加到有過年氛圍的活動呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 畢竟彼此都很忙呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 活動、周回、道具……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……老師，沒事吧？說什麼呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嘛，總之，那個……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天能占用你一點時間嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，新年開始了呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這樣的話，你不覺得先舉辦只有這個時期才有的活動，也是身為企業家該做的事情之一嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，雖然我不是特別信這套

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 沒錯！我不太相信

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 和我一起去抽籤吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: ……亞瑠是非常相信抽籤的人嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 別管那個了！快來！
